card.name: Migraine not resolved by 2 hours
card.fires_on: The word 'hours' (or the space before the number) in 'If the migraine has not resolved by 2 hours after taking' a triptan. Also weaker on words in emergency-readiness phrases about handling reactions or naloxone.

modes.label: Triptan redose timing
modes.description: The '2 hours' point in the instruction on what to do if a migraine has not resolved after a triptan dose.
modes.example: If the migraine has not resolved by 2<< hours>> after taking zolmitriptan

modes.label: Emergency readiness wording
modes.description: Words in phrases about being ready to handle anaphylaxis or overdose, such as reactions, treatment or immediate access.
modes.example: Administer PEMGARDA only in settings in which healthcare providers have<< immediate>> access to medications to treat anaphyl

card.plain: It marks the spot in triptan labels where a migraine that has not cleared by 2 hours is discussed, and weakly marks emergency-readiness phrases.
